title: Comparing external calibration and standard addition
summary: Spectrophotometric analysis of potassium ferricyanide using two calibration methods.
did: Prepared calibration standards, measured blank and sample absorbance at 420 nm, and used Excel regressions to compare external-standard calibration with standard addition. Recorded replicate measurements and calculated uncertainty, detection limits and concentrations.
why: Calibration choice affects how reliably an instrument signal can be translated into concentration, especially when other components in the sample alter that signal.
outcome: Produced a full report and calculation workbook documenting the method comparison and a large difference between the two concentration estimates, prompting discussion of matrix effects and measurement uncertainty.
note: The report records an exploratory method comparison. Agreement with a reference concentration was not established for the unknown; a high calibration R² alone does not establish accuracy.
credit: The report credits Duy Hoang and lab partner Rook Brianna. Original attribution is preserved.
